key_insight: The paper establishes almost sure boundedness and convergence of SGD to the set of critical points in deep linear networks trained with regularized squared loss.
engineering_relevance: The results strengthen the theoretical foundations of stochastic training in a tractable non-convex model, but do not establish guarantees for nonlinear networks.
method: Extend gradient-descent convergence analysis to stochastic updates.
Establish almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates.
Use asymptotic pseudotrajectories to prove convergence under deterministic and adaptive step-size choices.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees under mild conditions, without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data; it describes no empirical evaluation.
watch_item: Convergence to the critical-point set does not by itself guarantee convergence to a global optimum or provide a practical convergence rate.
paper_title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
